rationale: Shrink-only disclosure of ledger event types declared in src/gzkit/schemas/ledger.json that have never appeared in .gzkit/ledger.jsonl. An entry records a DISCLOSED absence, never a justified one: the type still owes either a producer or a retirement. Drain by wiring the producer or removing the declaration; this list may only decrease.

notes.section_ownership_unowned: OBPI-0.35.0-04. Producer IS wired -- `_append_event_once` in src/gzkit/commands/content/unown.py emits it on the attested raise-path. Zero rows exist because `gz content unown` has not yet been run against this repository; the day-one declaration was minted at genesis and no section has been un-owned. Drains on the first real un-owning.
notes.unowned_ratchet_updated: OBPI-0.35.0-04. Producer is `emit_unowned_ratchet_updated`, called only by `record_unowned_total`, which has NO production caller -- the disclosed, deliberate deferral recorded in the brief's Tracked Defects (Step-4b round-2 finding 3). Its caller is OBPI-0.35.0-05's materialization path. This entry is the honest witness that the type records nothing today, and it drains when that caller lands.
notes.ledger_event_corrected: GHI #611. Producer IS wired -- `ledger_correct_cmd` in src/gzkit/commands/ledger_correct.py mints the event via `ledger_event_corrected_event` and appends it. Zero rows exist because no correction has been applied to this repository's ledger yet: the three live targets (the wrongly-started OBPI-0.35.0-08 pipeline launch, and two task_blocked rows whose reason the operator resolved on 2026-08-24) are held for operator review before application, per the standing rule that only the operator initiates work against an OBPI's state. Drains on the first applied correction.
